title: Things Left to Do
selection_exposition: In the aftermath of B Protocol, Ft. Hurricane closes on Nisan and Nortune's buried vessel is ready to rise.<New>Beyond the battle, Rico faces a harder question: whether truth can change Kislev, and what place he wants in that change.<Close>
blocks:
CHAPTER 6
THINGS LEFT TO DO<New>The buried Fatima vessel.<Close>

<Bart>
Ft. Hurricane is closing on Nisan.
The vessel beneath Nortune is the only
weapon in range that can stop it.<Close>

<Bart>
The response is Fatima code. This
ship was waiting for my bloodline.<Close>

<Rico>
Then stop talking to us and tell it
to wake up.<Close>

<Bart>
You always know how to make a royal
occasion feel special.<Close>

<Fei>
The core is answering him.<Close>

Sigmund
Evacuation routes are clear. Central
District is under civil control.<New>The archived records and collar
shutdown survived B Protocol.<Close>

<Rico>
Then keep them that way.<New>Bart, you command the ship. I'll
make sure Nortune doesn't chain it
down again.<Close>

BATTLE REPORT
FT. HURRICANE: DESTROYED
NISAN: CLEAR<New>YGGDRASIL IV: ASCENDING<Close>

[When the battle ends, Sigmund's
voice is carried through every public
receiver in Nortune.]<Close>

Sigmund
Citizens of Kislev, I speak today
without a statement prepared by my
ministers.<Close>

Sigmund
Committee B diverted evacuation power,
confined workers, destroyed civil
records, and used a defense weapon
inside our capital.<Close>

Sigmund
Its authority is dissolved. Its
officers will answer before a public
tribunal.<Close>

Sigmund
Battling executions and forced
contracts are suspended. Collar
detonators are to be dismantled.<New>D Block ration and medical service
will continue under civil authority.<Close>

Sigmund
Imperial Code B and every decree that
denies demi-humans equal civil rights
are suspended pending repeal.<Close>

Sigmund
These measures were first advanced by
an Ethos faction while I was away.<New>I returned, found them useful to my
government, and left them in force.<Close>

Sigmund
That responsibility is mine.<Close>

Sigmund
Years ago, the Ethos performed illegal
procedures upon Anne Banderas and her
unborn child.<New>They expelled them and forged reports
of their deaths.<Close>

Sigmund
I believed those reports at first.<New>Later, when Ricardo Banderas opened
a family-sealed room, I found reason
to know they were false.<Close>

Sigmund
I protected my office and returned
him to Committee custody.<New>I abandoned my son, and the power of
this government carried out that
choice.<Close>

[Across D Block, collar lights go
dark. A holding gate opens.]<Close>

BATTLER
Is this another trick?<Close>

DEMI-HUMAN WORKER
Maybe. But the gate is open.<Close>

OLD PRISONER
Then we step through it together.<Close>

[There is no instant celebration.
Some prisoners move. Some cannot yet
believe the wall will let them pass.]<Close>

Sigmund
Rico, the council will ask who is to
stand beside me when the old order is
replaced.<Close>

<Rico>
Tell them to stand beside the people
they kept underneath it.<New>I am not taking a throne so everyone
can pretend the throne was the only
problem.<Close>

Sigmund
Will you return?<Close>

<Rico>
There are still people fighting
Solaris, and I'm going with them.<New>After that, there are things here I
intend to see finished.<Close>

Sigmund
I will not ask you for more.<Close>

<Rico>
Good. Do the work you already promised.<Close>

Rico leaves Nortune without an
Imperial title. For the first time,
he leaves by choice.<Close>
CHAPTER 6 COMPLETE<Close>
